quote_json: "From any interface-type S to any interface-type T, provided S is derived from T."
requirement: A value statically typed as the incorporated IEnumerator<T> has no implicit reference conversion to IEnumerator merely from that interface type.
retirement_reason: Annex D declares IEnumerator<T> : IDisposable, IEnumerator. Subclause 2 requires support for the documented library, and 13.1.4 therefore permits this base-interface conversion. Generic invariance is a separate requirement.
